generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Define and enforce token, call, monetary, compute, and storage budgets and quotas by provider, model, project, or task; track consumption, warn near limits, and block or reroute work when hard limits are reached.

contract.purpose_user_function: Configure and enforce selected daily call/token budgets and per-operator/provider quota/cooldown policies, then prevent unavailable operators from receiving work.
contract.valid_inputs: daily_call_limit, daily_token_limit, hard_stop and current counters in codex-budget.json; operator quota thresholds/actions/reset times; provider failure text and runtime-state evidence.
contract.expected_outputs: Budget remaining/status, consume/reset results, operator available/blocked decision, cooldown/quota state, reset time, and status/dashboard warnings.
contract.state_side_effects: Consumes/resets daily counters atomically and persists operator quota/auth/cooldown blocks; expired blocks can be pruned; routing may avoid or delay blocked operators.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Hard-stop returns failure at call/token limits; quota/auth/capacity evidence blocks the operator; expired blocks clear; malformed or missing budget files can make checks/status unavailable.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Token/call and operator quota controls are implemented. General monetary, compute and storage budgets by arbitrary provider/model/project/task, soft warning policy, and cost-based rerouting are incomplete or not found.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Counter defaults/reset; consume; hard-stop on/off; at/below/above token and call limits; operator quota/auth/capacity classification; cooldown expiry; fallback/reroute policy; missing budget file; unsupported monetary/compute/storage dimension.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md: provider quota fail-closed boundary; INSTALL.md: live provider readiness; docs/DISTRIBUTED_DEPLOYMENT_ANALYSIS.md: Cost estimates.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/codex-budget.sh check/consume/reset/status; status-server GET /usage and /status; operator-flow-control library used by dispatch paths.
contract.config_schemas: harness/config/physical-operators.schema.json quota fields and on_exhausted; harness/config/agent-actors.schema.json cost_profile; codex-budget runtime JSON has no separate checked-in schema.
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/codex-budget.sh cmd_check/cmd_consume/cmd_reset/cmd_status; harness/lib/operator_flow_control.py ensure_operator_available, persist_operator_block, prune_expired_operator_config_blocks and apply_failure_flow_control.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Observable quota/reset data depends on provider CLI output/local logs; Codex account-wide usage is unavailable; enforcement is local and does not change external provider billing limits.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/codex-budget.sh cmd_check/cmd_consume/cmd_reset/cmd_status; harness/lib/operator_flow_control.py ensure_operator_available, persist_operator_block, prune_expired_operator_config_blocks and apply_failure_flow_control.
implementation.interfaces: harness/codex-budget.sh check/consume/reset/status; status-server GET /usage and /status; operator-flow-control library used by dispatch paths.
implementation.schemas_and_config: harness/config/physical-operators.schema.json quota fields and on_exhausted; harness/config/agent-actors.schema.json cost_profile; codex-budget runtime JSON has no separate checked-in schema.
